image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a white audio cassette tape. The image shows the two circular spools with visible magnetic tape wound around them, separated by black plastic internal structures. A rectangular label area in the lower center contains handwritten orange text. There are small molded details like screw holes and write-protect tabs visible on the bottom edge. The top edge has some faint, illegible printed text.

The orange handwriting on the label lacks realistic ink bleed or pen pressure variation, appearing slightly 'painted' or soft rather than written with a marker.
The central hole of the left spool seems slightly irregular and not perfectly circular, suggesting minor geometric distortion.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text artifacts. AI often fails to render crisp, legible text on small objects like cassettes. Check if the 'handwriting' looks physically plausible (ink flow) or just like orange shapes. Verify if the spool teeth are uniform or if they melt into each other.
